'''Dror Fixler''' ({{Langx|he|דרור פיקסלר}}) is an Israeli [[physicist]] specializing in optics. Since 2026 he is a Full Professor in [[Tel Aviv University]]. He was the director of the Bar-Ilan institute of nanotechnology and advanced materials, a Professor of [[Electrical engineering]] and [[Nanophotonics]] at [[Bar-Ilan University]] in [[Ramat Gan|Ramat Gan, Israel]]. He is also a visiting professor in Technical Institute of Physics and Chemistry, China. He is also an Israeli Orthodox rabbi and posek, and a student of Rabbi [[Nahum Rabinovitch|Nahum Eliezer Rabinovitch]].<ref name=hz>{{cite web|last1=Efrati|first1=Ido|title=Israeli Physicist Uses Gold to Help Detect Cancer Early|url=https://www.haaretz.com/science-and-health/2014-08-16/ty-article/.premium/using-gold-to-detect-tumors/0000017f-e64d-d62c-a1ff-fe7fc3c80000|website=[[Haaretz]]|access-date=20 April 2017|language=en|date=16 August 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Gargling with Gold Nanoparticles Provides a Non-invasive Way to Diagnose Cancer and May Provide Pathologists with a Useful New Clinical Laboratory Test|url=http://www.darkdaily.com/gargling-with-gold-nanoparticles-provides-a-non-invasive-way-to-diagnose-cancer-and-may-provide-pathologists-with-a-useful-new-clinical-laboratory-test-1103#axzz4eoiya8sp|website=[[The Dark Report]]|date=3 November 2014 |accessdate=20 April 2017}}</ref>

Fixler is a member of the Nano Photonics Center at the Institute of Nanotechnology and Advanced Materials,<ref name=hz /> and a Lecturer at the Faculty of Engineering.<ref>{{cite web|title=Prof. Dror Fixler {{!}} Faculty of Engineering|url=http://www.eng.biu.ac.il/fixlerd/|website=[[Bar-Ilan University]]|accessdate=20 April 2017}}</ref>

In 2015, Fixler received [[European Science Foundation]]’s Plasmon-Bionanosense Award.<ref>{{cite web|title=European Science Foundation's Plasmon-Bionanosense Award Granted To Dr. Dror Fixler|url=http://birad.co.il/new/european-science-foundations-plasmon-bionanosense-award-granted-dr-dror-fixler/|website=Birad|accessdate=20 April 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160628000303/http://birad.co.il/new/european-science-foundations-plasmon-bionanosense-award-granted-dr-dror-fixler/|archive-date=28 June 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 2017, Fixler received the President's International Fellowship Initiative Award of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS).<ref>{{cite web|title=Faculty of Engineering Prof. Dror Fixler Honored by Chinese Academy of Sciences|url=http://www1.biu.ac.il/indexE.php/indexE.php?id=3&pt=20&pid=4&level=1&cPath=4&type=1&news=2883|website=Bar-Ilan University|accessdate=20 April 2017|language=en}}</ref>

==Research==
Fixler is expert in electro-optics and photonics research including the emission, transmission, detection and sensing of light for biomedical properties.<ref>{{cite web|title=Les juifs peuvent-ils conduire une voiture automatique pendant le shabbat?|url=http://www.slate.fr/lien/36659/conduire-voiture-futur-shabbat|website=[[Slate magazine]]|date=8 April 2011 |accessdate=20 April 2017|language=fr-FR}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Sharon|first1=Itamar|title=Israeli study uses gold particles to 'seek and destroy' artery blockages|url=https://www.timesofisrael.com/israeli-study-uses-gold-particles-to-search-and-destroy-artery-blockages/|website=[[The Times of Israel]]|accessdate=20 April 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Siegel-Itzkovich|first1=Judy|title=Will rabbis allow brainy Shabbat driving?|url=https://www.jpost.com/Enviro-Tech/Will-rabbis-allow-brainy-Shabbat-driving|website=[[The Jerusalem Post]]|date=8 April 2011 |accessdate=20 April 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Miller|first1=Jason|title=Just Thinking About Driving on Shabbat|url=http://jewishweek.timesofisrael.com/just-thinking-about-driving-on-shabbat/|website=[[New York Jewish Week]]|accessdate=20 April 2017}}</ref>
